title.zh-TW: 好友可得抵用金或首購折扣
title.en: Friend reward: credit or first-purchase discount

text.zh-TW: 依官方推薦計畫條款，獎勵可能是固定金額抵用金（舉例 $20）或首購折扣（推薦計畫頁寫 5%）；實際是哪一種，以註冊與結帳頁為準。
text.en: Per the referral terms, a fixed credit (e.g. $20) or a first-purchase discount (5% on the program page); checkout shows which applies.

title.en: Free domain for the first year

text.zh-TW: 方案比較頁列出 Starter、Pro、Max 含首年免費網域；適用的網域後綴與續約價格官方未載明，請在結帳頁確認。
text.en: The plan comparison page lists it for Starter, Pro and Max; eligible endings and renewal prices are not stated, so check at checkout.

text.zh-TW: 共享等方案含免費搬站；來源主機須提供 cPanel 帳號資料，從非 cPanel 的主機搬來可能另收費用（官方退款與計費政策）。
text.en: Included in the plans; you must provide cPanel details, and a move from a non-cPanel host may cost extra (official refund and billing policy).

text.zh-TW: 共享主機標示 30 天；限首期、每位客戶只能使用一次，網域註冊費、設定費與搬站費不退款。
text.en: Listed for shared hosting; first term only and once per customer, and domain, setup and migration fees are not refunded.

text.zh-TW: 官方標示以即時聊天、電話與工單全年無休服務，另有 AI 助理 Orbi；可用語言官方未載明，建議用英文提問。
text.en: Live chat, phone and tickets at all hours, plus the Orbi AI assistant; supported languages are not stated, so English is the safe choice.

text.zh-TW: 共享與雲端方案列有美國、新加坡、倫敦、雪梨、孟買、法蘭克福；台灣訪客通常優先考慮新加坡。
text.en: Shared and cloud plans list the USA, Singapore, London, Sydney, Mumbai and Frankfurt; Singapore is usually the nearest for Taiwan.

text.zh-TW: 推薦人可就新客戶的首次合格購買獲得佣金，審核期 45 天；金額與條件以 Hosting.com 官方公告為準。
text.en: Referrers earn a commission on a new customer's first eligible purchase, held 45 days for review; amounts follow Hosting.com's announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會在新分頁開啟）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it opens in a new tab).

steps.zh-TW: 比較共享主機的 Starter、Pro、Max 方案，依網站數量與儲存空間選一個；資料中心可先考慮新加坡。
steps.en: Compare the Starter, Pro and Max shared plans and pick one by number of sites and storage; Singapore is a sensible first data center to consider.

steps.zh-TW: 在結帳頁確認折扣或抵用金、首年免費網域與免費搬站是否已套用，再付款。
steps.en: At checkout, confirm that the discount or credit, the free first-year domain and the free migration are applied before you pay.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊後登入 Hosting Panel，可一鍵安裝 WordPress，或申請免費搬站。
steps.en: After signing up, log in to the Hosting Panel to install WordPress in one click or to request the free migration.

steps.zh-TW: 朋友獎勵若是抵用金，要等購買後 45 天審核期結束才會入帳，期間需保持有效客戶。
steps.en: If the friend reward is an account credit, it arrives only after the 45-day review period, and you must stay an active customer until then.

intro.zh-TW: Hosting.com 虛擬主機推薦連結：官方列有首年免費網域、免費搬站與 24/7/365 客服，好友透過連結註冊可能獲得朋友獎勵。
intro.en: Hosting.com web hosting referral link: the official site lists a free first-year domain, free migration and 24/7/365 support; friends may get a reward.

description.zh-TW:
Hosting.com 是提供網站主機服務的主機商，網站經營者可以租用空間放置自己的網站；產品包含共享主機、WordPress 主機、VPS、專用伺服器與轉售主機。它是 World Host Group 旗下的全球品牌：2025 年，A2 Hosting 加入集團並更名為 hosting.com。官方 About 頁自述服務超過 20 年（自 2003 年起）、客戶 70 萬以上。

共享主機有三個方案，以下是官方方案比較頁在 2026 年 10 月 30 日的內容：

- **Starter**：5 個網站、15 GB NVMe 儲存空間。
- **Pro**：10 個網站、50 GB NVMe，另有預備站（staging）、WordPress Toolkit 與更多 CPU、記憶體。
- **Max**：50 個網站、100 GB NVMe，另有 40 個信箱、服務水準協議（SLA）、進階 SSL 與優先客服。

三個方案都列有 SSL 憑證、免費代為搬站與首年免費網域，也都有一鍵安裝 WordPress；共享方案的資料中心列有美國、新加坡、倫敦、雪梨、孟買與法蘭克福，實際可選的地點以訂購頁為準。

這是推薦人專屬的邀請連結，沒有另外的邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結註冊。方案內容、價格與優惠會調整，下單前請以官方頁面與結帳畫面為準。
description.en:
Hosting.com is a web hosting provider where site owners rent space for their websites. Its products include shared hosting, WordPress hosting, VPS, dedicated servers and reseller hosting. It is a global brand of World Host Group: in 2025 A2 Hosting joined the group and was renamed hosting.com. Its About page says it has served customers for more than 20 years (since 2003) and has 700,000+ clients.

Shared hosting comes in three plans. This is what the official plan comparison page showed on October 30, 2026:

- **Starter**: 5 websites and 15 GB of NVMe storage.
- **Pro**: 10 websites and 50 GB of NVMe storage, plus staging sites, WordPress Toolkit and more CPU and RAM.
- **Max**: 50 websites and 100 GB of NVMe storage, plus 40 mailboxes, a service level agreement, premium SSL and priority support.

All three list an SSL certificate, free managed migration, a free domain for the first year and one-click WordPress install. The data centers listed for shared plans are the USA, Singapore, London, Sydney, Mumbai and Frankfurt; the locations you can actually choose are shown when you order.

This is the referrer's personal link and there is no separate code to type, so register through the link on this page. Plans, prices and offers change, so rely on the official pages and the checkout screen before you pay.

notes.zh-TW:
這是推薦人專屬連結（網址內含推薦人識別碼），沒有可手動輸入的短碼，請直接透過連結註冊。透過它註冊，推薦人可能依 Hosting.com 的推薦計畫獲得佣金。

本頁的方案、資料中心、客服與條款整理自 Hosting.com 官方網站（2026 年 10 月 30 日檢視）。方案內容、價格與優惠會調整，朋友獎勵的形式與金額也由 Hosting.com 決定，下單前請以官方頁面與結帳畫面為準。

免費網域只有第一年；退款保證限首期、只能使用一次，且不含網域註冊費。共享主機是多個網站共用一台伺服器的資源，流量或功能需求變大時，可改選 VPS 或專用伺服器。
notes.en:
This is the referrer's personal link (its address carries the referrer's identifier) with no short code to type in, so sign up through the link itself. Through it the referrer may earn a commission under Hosting.com's referral program.

The plans, data centers, support and terms on this page were compiled from Hosting.com's official website (viewed October 30, 2026). Plans, prices and offers change, and Hosting.com decides the form and amount of the friend reward, so rely on the official pages and the checkout screen before you pay.

The free domain covers the first year only, and the money-back guarantee applies to the first term, can be used once, and excludes domain registration fees. Shared hosting means many sites share one server's resources; if your traffic or feature needs grow, consider a VPS or a dedicated server.

q.zh-TW: Hosting.com 是什麼？和 A2 Hosting 有什麼關係？
q.en: What is Hosting.com, and how is it related to A2 Hosting?

a.zh-TW:
Hosting.com 是提供共享主機、WordPress 主機、VPS、專用伺服器與轉售主機的網站主機商。2025 年，A2 Hosting 加入 World Host Group 並更名為 hosting.com；官方 About 頁說明，這個品牌整合了集團與 A2 Hosting 的團隊和技術。

官方自述的數字（2026 年 10 月 30 日檢視）：服務超過 20 年（自 2003 年起）、客戶 70 萬以上、託管網站 300 萬個以上、服務 181 個國家。這些是 Hosting.com 自己公布的，本站沒有獨立查證。
a.en:
Hosting.com is a web hosting provider offering shared, WordPress, VPS, dedicated and reseller hosting. In 2025 A2 Hosting joined World Host Group and was renamed hosting.com; the About page says the brand brings together the teams and technology of the group and A2 Hosting.

The company's own figures (viewed October 30, 2026): more than 20 years of service (since 2003), 700,000+ clients, 3 million+ websites hosted and customers in 181 countries. These numbers come from Hosting.com itself and were not independently checked.

q.zh-TW: Hosting.com 邀請連結有什麼優惠？
q.en: What does the Hosting.com referral link offer?

a.zh-TW:
好友透過邀請連結註冊，可能獲得一次性的朋友獎勵，推薦人則依官方推薦計畫獲得佣金。官方推薦計畫條款寫明，朋友獎勵可以是固定金額的帳戶抵用金（條款舉例 $20），也可以是首次購買的折扣；形式與金額由 Hosting.com 決定並隨時調整。推薦計畫頁目前寫的是 5% 折扣，並免費搬遷網站。

官方條款的條件：

- 只適用合格產品（共享主機、WordPress 主機、VPS、轉售主機等），網域、信箱方案與附加項目不算。
- 朋友要在購買後 45 天內保持有效客戶；獎勵若是抵用金，審核期結束後自動入帳，只能折抵 Hosting.com 的服務，不能換現金。
- 不能與其他優惠或折扣碼合併。

本頁連結實際適用哪一種獎勵，請以註冊頁與結帳頁的顯示為準。
a.en:
A friend who signs up through a referral link may get a one-time friend reward, and the referrer earns a commission under Hosting.com's referral program. The program terms say the reward can be a fixed account credit (the terms give $20 as an example) or a discount on the first purchase; Hosting.com decides the form and amount and can change them at any time. The program page currently says a 5% discount plus free website migration.

Conditions from the official terms:

- Only eligible products count (shared, WordPress, VPS, reseller hosting and similar); domains, email plans and add-ons do not.
- The friend must stay an active customer for 45 days after the purchase. A credit is added automatically after that review period, can only be used toward Hosting.com services and has no cash value.
- The reward cannot be combined with other promotions or coupon codes.

The sign-up and checkout pages show which reward the link on this page gives.

a.zh-TW:
虛擬主機（共享主機）是主機商把一台實體伺服器切成多個獨立空間，分別租給不同的用戶放網站。硬體成本由多人分攤，費用比自己養一台伺服器低得多，所以多數站長都是租用現成的主機。

如果把網址想成門牌，虛擬主機就是門牌後面那間放得下網站檔案的房子。網站流量變大、需要更多資源時，常見的下一步是改用 VPS（有獨立分配資源的虛擬伺服器）或專用伺服器。
a.en:
Shared hosting, also called virtual hosting, means a hosting company splits one physical server into many separate spaces and rents each one to a different customer. Because the hardware cost is shared, it is far cheaper than running your own server, which is why most site owners rent hosting instead.

If your domain name is the street address, hosting is the building behind it that holds your site's files. When a site outgrows shared hosting, the usual next steps are a VPS (a virtual server with its own reserved resources) or a dedicated server.

q.zh-TW: 架設網站需要準備哪些東西？
q.en: What do I need to build a website?

a.zh-TW:
需要三樣：網域、主機與網站本身。

- **網域**：訪客輸入的網址，像門牌一樣讓人找到你的網站。
- **主機**：存放網站檔案與資料的伺服器空間，需要租用。
- **網站設計與內容**：用 WordPress 之類的架站平台套版面、放文章與圖片，或自己寫程式。

用 WordPress 架站的順序通常是：先決定網站目的，再選網域與主機，安裝 WordPress，設定 SSL 並把網域指向主機，最後設計版面、上線並持續維護。網域與主機在同一家購買，通常不必另外處理網域指向的設定；Hosting.com 的共享方案列有一鍵安裝 WordPress 與首年免費網域。
a.en:
You need three things: a domain name, hosting and the site itself.

- **Domain name**: the address visitors type to reach your site.
- **Hosting**: the server space that stores your site's files and data. You rent it.
- **Site design and content**: built with a platform such as WordPress, or coded by hand.

A typical WordPress setup runs in this order: decide what the site is for, pick a domain and hosting, install WordPress, set up SSL and point the domain at the hosting, then design the pages, publish and keep the site maintained. Buying the domain and hosting from the same company usually saves you the separate step of pointing the domain at the server. Hosting.com's shared plans list one-click WordPress install and a free domain for the first year.

q.zh-TW: 網域怎麼取名？.com 和 .tw 該選哪個？
q.en: How do I choose a domain name, and should I pick .com or .tw?

a.zh-TW:
取名的原則是簡短好記、容易輸入與分享。

- 用品牌名稱，或與你的產品、服務有關的字。
- 英文或拼音比中文網域好用：中文網域在部分系統會以 Punycode 顯示成一串英數字。
- 網址帶不帶 www 都能用，選定一種當主要版本，並讓另一種自動導向它。

後綴（頂級域名）首選 .com：辨識度最高、用途不受限。想鎖定單一市場，可選國碼網域，例如 .tw、.com.tw、.cn、.jp。.co 常被當作 .com 被註冊走時的替代（它其實是哥倫比亞的國碼網域）。.net、.org、.info 各自暗示網路服務、組織與資訊型網站，但通常不限制誰可以註冊。喜歡的名字被註冊走了，換個後綴常常還註冊得到。
a.en:
Keep it short, easy to remember and easy to type or share.

- Use your brand name, or a word tied to your product or service.
- English or romanized names are easier to use than Chinese domains, which some systems show as a Punycode string of letters and digits.
- The address works with or without www. Pick one version as the main one and redirect the other to it.

For the ending (top-level domain), .com is the safe default: widely recognized and open to any use. Country-code domains such as .tw, .com.tw, .cn or .jp suit sites aimed at one market. .co is often used as a fallback when the .com is taken (it is actually Colombia's country code). .net, .org and .info suggest network services, organizations and information sites, but are usually open to anyone. If the name you want is taken, a different ending often still works.

q.en: How do I choose a hosting plan?

a.zh-TW:
依序比較這幾項：

- **公司與服務**：營運歷史、客服管道與時間、備份與安全機制。
- **效能與規格**：儲存類型（NVMe SSD 的讀寫速度比傳統硬碟快）、可放的網站數、CPU 與記憶體上限、有沒有快取。
- **資料中心位置**：離主要訪客越近，延遲通常越低。
- **價格**：除了首購價，也看續約費用、儲存與流量限制，以及備份、信箱、SSL、CDN 是否另外收費。
- **擴充性**：流量變大時能不能升級到 VPS 或專用伺服器，搬站麻不麻煩。

沒有哪一家在所有項目都最好。先寫下訪客在哪裡、預期流量與預算，再用這份清單比較。
a.en:
Compare these points in order:

- **Company and service**: track record, support channels and hours, backups and security.
- **Performance and specs**: storage type (NVMe SSD is faster than a traditional hard disk), number of sites allowed, CPU and memory limits, caching.
- **Data center location**: the closer to your visitors, the lower the latency usually is.
- **Price**: look beyond the first-term price to the renewal price, storage and traffic limits, and whether backups, email, SSL and a CDN cost extra.
- **Room to grow**: whether you can move up to a VPS or dedicated server and how painful a migration would be.

No provider is best at everything. Write down where your visitors are, your expected traffic and your budget, then compare against this list.

q.en: Does Hosting.com give a free domain?

a.zh-TW:
有，但只有第一年。官方方案比較頁列出 Starter、Pro、Max 三個共享方案，以及雲端伺服器與裸機方案都含「首年免費網域」。

官方頁面沒有說明哪些網域後綴不適用，也沒有寫第二年起的續約價格。服務條款寫明，網域促銷只適用新註冊的網域（轉入與續約不算），並依購買當時公布的資格條件而定；網域註冊費也不在 30 天退款保證的範圍內。下單前請在結帳頁確認想要的後綴是否免費。
a.en:
Yes, but only for the first year. The official plan comparison page lists a free first-year domain for the Starter, Pro and Max shared plans, as well as cloud server and bare metal plans.

The official pages do not say which domain endings are excluded or what the renewal price is from the second year. The service terms say domain promotions apply only to new registrations (not transfers or renewals) and depend on the eligibility criteria shown at purchase, and domain registration fees are outside the 30-day money-back guarantee. Check at checkout that the ending you want is free.

q.zh-TW: Hosting.com 有新加坡機房嗎？台灣訪客適合嗎？
q.en: Does Hosting.com have a Singapore data center, and is it a good fit for visitors in Taiwan?

a.zh-TW:
有。官方方案比較頁列出共享主機與雲端伺服器的資料中心：美國、新加坡、倫敦、雪梨、孟買、法蘭克福；裸機方案只有美國。

新加坡離台灣比美國與歐洲近，通常是台灣訪客的優先選擇，但實際速度還取決於網站內容、快取與外掛。官方沒有公布固定的載入時間，建議上線後用 PageSpeed Insights 或 WebPageTest 測自己的網站。可選的地點以訂購頁為準。
a.en:
Yes. The official plan comparison page lists data centers in the USA, Singapore, London, Sydney, Mumbai and Frankfurt for shared hosting and cloud servers; bare metal plans are USA only.

Singapore is closer to Taiwan than the USA or Europe, so it is usually the first choice for Taiwanese visitors, but real speed also depends on your content, caching and plugins. Hosting.com publishes no fixed load time, so test your own site with PageSpeed Insights or WebPageTest after launch. The locations you can choose are shown when you order.

q.zh-TW: Hosting.com 客服有 24 小時嗎？可以用中文嗎？
q.en: Is Hosting.com support available 24 hours a day, and does it speak Chinese?

a.zh-TW:
有 24 小時客服。官方標示以即時聊天、電話與工單提供 24/7/365（全年無休）支援，並由 AI 助理 Orbi 先回答問題，必要時轉給自家團隊的真人。

官方方案比較頁把「多語系支援」列為內建項目，但沒有寫支援哪些語言，所以有沒有中文客服無法確認。用簡單的英文提問（必要時搭配翻譯工具）最保險。
a.en:
Yes to 24 hours. The official site says support is available 24/7/365 by live chat, phone and tickets, with an AI assistant named Orbi answering first and handing over to the in-house team when needed.

The plan comparison page lists multilingual support as included but does not say which languages, so Chinese support is not confirmed. Writing in simple English, with a translation tool if needed, is the safest option.

q.zh-TW: Hosting.com 可以免費搬站、退款嗎？
q.en: Does Hosting.com offer free site migration and a money-back guarantee?

a.zh-TW:
兩者都有，但都有條件。

- **免費搬站**：方案比較頁列出各方案含免費代為搬遷。來源主機須提供 cPanel 帳號資料；從非 cPanel 的主機搬來，官方政策表示可能依複雜度另收費用。
- **30 天退款保證**：共享主機標示 30 天。限首期、每位客戶只能使用一次；網域註冊、續約與轉入不適用，網域註冊費、設定費與搬站費不退款。雲端伺服器與裸機方案的退款期間，請看官方方案比較頁。
a.en:
Yes to both, with conditions.

- **Free migration**: the plan comparison page lists free managed migration for every plan. You must give your previous host's cPanel account details; for a move from a non-cPanel host, the official policy says a fee may apply depending on complexity.
- **30-day money-back guarantee**: shared hosting is listed with 30 days. It covers the first term only and can be used once per customer; domain registrations, renewals and transfers are excluded, and domain, setup and migration fees are non-refundable. For cloud server and bare metal plans, check the refund period on the official plan comparison page.
